content: msb_krun 0.1.41 (superradcompany fork of libkrun, used by microsandbox): safe Rust builder API VmBuilder with machine/kernel(initramfs_path,init_path,krunfw_path)/disk(path,read_only)/vsock(unix_connect,unix_listen)/exec. TSI inet hijack defaults to false (air-gapped). net() only with net feature. Vm::enter() never returns; VMM _exit()s process on guest shutdown. Reads env MSB_KRUN_KERNEL_CMDLINE and HOSTNAME. Compiles on macOS 27 arm64 with forbid(unsafe_code) in caller; features [blk] tree has no cc/C build; links Hypervisor.framework; kernel from libkrunfw dylib via dlopen.
